privacy_entity.label: Privacy mode switch
privacy_entity.description: The camera's Privacy switch (tapo_control creates it as switch.<camera>_privacy). While it is on, the lens is closed and the image sensor and IR LEDs are off.

night_vision_entity.label: Night vision switching select
night_vision_entity.description: The camera's Night Vision Switching select (tapo_control creates it as select.<camera>_night_vision_switching, options auto/on/off). Forced on or off is honoured; on auto the sun is used as the proxy for IR.

fixed_config.power: {% set nv = states('[[night_vision_entity]]') %}{% if is_state('[[privacy_entity]]', 'on') %}1.95{% elif nv == 'on' %}3.32{% elif nv == 'off' %}2.23{% else %}{{ 3.32 if is_state('sun.sun', 'below_horizon') else 2.23 }}{% endif %}

measure_description: Measured manually with a Shelly Plus Plug UK, polling its Switch.GetStatus apower every 2 s and averaging, with the camera on its own USB adapter (the adapter's draw is included). Privacy mode on: 1.95 W; watching by day (night vision forced off, colour image): 2.23 W; watching at night (night vision forced on, IR LEDs lit, black-and-white image): 3.32 W. 60-90 s per state after settling, repeated privacy readings agreed within 0.05 W. tapo_control has no day/night sensor, so the Night Vision Switching select decides: forced on uses the IR figure, forced off the day figure, and on auto the sun is the proxy for IR. Firmware 1.4.2 Build 260302.
name: Tapo C125 AI Home Security Wi-Fi Camera
